method: AI-assisted qualitative review against the frozen development ground truth; no holdout cases were executed.

iterations.name: production_baseline
iterations.finding: Structurally reliable, but Persian prose contains literal translations, vague behavior, omitted branches, and unnatural terminology.

iterations.name: candidate_1_english_style_rules
iterations.finding: No consistent prose improvement. New malformed technical translations appeared and important control paths remained omitted.

iterations.name: candidate_2_final_persian_rules
iterations.finding: Still produced unnatural terminology and incomplete behavior, violated the no-numbered-list instruction, and introduced one invalid-JSON failure.

case_findings.evidence: Both candidates used malformed Persian terminology for trie and reduced the traversal behavior to a generic boolean lookup.
Both candidates remained title-like or grammatically broken and did not clearly explain the password-to-id lookup and phone comparison.
The final candidate was clearer, but exception branches and return wording were still incomplete.
Both candidates omitted or distorted review ordering, authenticated-form creation, and template rendering details.
Technical vocabulary and error semantics remained unnatural; raising ValueError was incorrectly described as returning it.
The first candidate used a numbered list despite the style rule and the final candidate failed JSON validation.

interpretation: The remaining Persian prose weakness is primarily a local Qwen generation limitation under this contract, not a failure of deterministic facts or citation composition. More tuning on six cases would risk overfitting without evidence of general improvement.
